[[File:Rebel_sergeant_major.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sergeant major]]
'''Sergeant Major''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A Sergeant Major was a senior non-commissioned officer, typically serving as the second-in-command of a [[Platoon/Legends|Platoon]], and as the adjutant to the unit's commanding [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]].

A Sergeant Major would also be second-in-command to [[Cadet Leader]]s during their [[Omega Exercise]]s in which they had to lead a platoon of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] into real combat. [[Hong]], for instance, was [[Kyle Katarn]]'s Sergeant Major during Katarn's Omega Exercise on [[AX-456]].

Sergeant-Major was also a rank given to [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. These troopers had green markings in the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and like the rank equivalent in the Galactic Empire, commonly served as second-in-command of a platoon.
